title: AI ko browser chalana sikhao
content:
[HOOK: screen - browser clicking by itself]
Ye browser main nahi chala raha...
AI chala raha hai.

[SCREEN: github.com/browser-use/browser-use - release 0.13.13 | Oct 15, 2026]
Open-source project Browser Use ne...
OpenAI ke Python SDK ke liye browser tools release kiye.

[GRAPHIC: 18 default browser tools | Source: Browser Use GitHub release 0.13.13]
18 default browser tools.
Navigate, click, type... sab ready.
Local browser ho ya cloud browser, dono chalenge.

[SCREEN: terminal - pip install "browser-use[openai-tools]"]
Setup simple hai.
Step one... install the openai-tools extra.
Step two... OpenAI Python 3.31 ya usse naya.
Step three... apna task likho, jaise "price compare karo."

[CAM: close-up]
Par limits bhi jaan lo.
Uploads, downloads aur Bash...
abhi SUPPORT nahi hain.
Read the release notes before you build on it.

[CAM: face]
Builder tip.
Pehle ek boring repeat task choose karo.
Wahi automate karo. Wahi asli value hai.

[CTA]
Follow for daily AI, explained by a builder.
